observations: Large yellow industrial engine with a black top casing.
A red vertical pipe and a silver horizontal pipe are attached to the side.
Various hoses, wires, and a black air intake pipe are visible.
The engine is sitting on a grassy area next to a concrete wall.
The engine block shows significant rust and surface wear.
A watermark 'DIN EQUIPMENT SALES AND' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The engine is visible in photo 0, but the specific model designation is not legible on the casing.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical failure or seized components.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running and a compression test report.

risks.risk: Missing critical accessories like the alternator, fuel pump, or governor.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included parts laid out.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or structural damage in the cylinder head or block.
risks.proof: Clear photos of the top and bottom of the engine block.

risks.risk: High mileage or excessive wear on the pistons and rings.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine's service history or a mileage sticker.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the engine running to confirm it is functional.
Photo of the engine with all included accessories.
Clear photos of the engine block and cylinder head.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
